items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: this boy Harold DeJean, myself, Jake Coochie was on piano... only four pieces there.

ctx.x: Remember one place up there you used to call it the dog house or something?

No, this boy Harold DeJean, myself, Jake Coochie was on piano, I was on band-juro, Harold DeJean was on saxophone, and let's see, can I recall a drummer? I can't recall a drummer, but anyway, Jake Coochie was on piano, I was on banjo and Harold DeJean on saxophone, only four pieces there.
Just ask a minute ago about any other favorite musicians, if you remember, of the old timers on any instrument at all, if you like to hear.
